zoekt_auto_delete_lost_nodes.description: If lost nodes and related records should get automatically deleted

zoekt_cache_response.description: If the results needs to be cached

zoekt_indexing_enabled.description: If zoekt indexing is enabled for the instance

zoekt_indexing_paused.description: If zoekt indexing is paused for the instance
